scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd apps/backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:backend: cd apps/backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
